content: This flowchart provides a detailed strategy for reducing cardiovascular risk in patients aged 18 years or older who have type 2 diabetes (T2D) and at least one of the following conditions: atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD), heart failure (HF), diabetic kidney disease (DKD), or a high risk for ASCVD. The approach emphasizes the concurrent management of multiple factors to optimize patient outcomes. It specifically highlights the use of SGLT2 inhibitors or GLP-1 receptor agonists as part of the therapeutic regimen to address these risks.
